description: Get an authenticated download URL (plus size/status metadata) for a specific HyperExecute job artifact. Requires artefactName (from getHyperExecuteJobArtifacts); optionally scope to a task with taskId. Returns a URL to fetch with your LambdaTest credentials rather than the raw file bytes.

artefactName.description: Name of the artifact to download (as returned by getHyperExecuteJobArtifacts)

jobId.description: The HyperExecute job ID whose artifact to download

taskId.description: Optional: scope the artifact to a specific task ID

name: downloadJobArtifact
title: Download Job Artifact
